Construct a grid signature for a multidimensional VRT

Source: R/vrtstack-core.R
mdim_signature.Rd

One row (as a list) per collection: the grid geometry and array metadata the emitter needs, derived from catalog metadata or a single cached probe. The emitter trusts these values, so a collection with non-aligned assets is a signature-gate refusal, never a resample.

Usage

mdim_signature(
  collection,
  variable,
  nx,
  ny,
  x0,
  dx,
  y0,
  dy,
  srs,
  dtype,
  nodata = NA,
  scale = NA,
  offset = NA,
  unit = NA_character_,
  steps_per_file = 1L,
  chunk_nx = NA_integer_,
  chunk_ny = NA_integer_,
  provenance = "probe"
)

Arguments

collection, variable

Identifiers for the collection and data array.

nx, ny

Grid dimensions in X and Y.

x0, dx, y0, dy

Grid origin and spacing as pixel-centre coordinates in the array's own orientation (dy is typically negative for north-up grids).

srs

Spatial reference (e.g. "EPSG:4326" or a WKT string).

dtype

VRT data type of the array (e.g. "Int16", "Float32").

nodata, scale, offset, unit

Optional array metadata; NA to omit.

steps_per_file

Number of concat-axis steps stored in each source file.

chunk_nx, chunk_ny

Optional source chunk (block) shape, recorded for later byte-range harvesting.

provenance

Free text recording where the grid facts came from (catalog, probe, or a published grid).

Value

A named list describing one collection's grid and array metadata.

See also

mdim_sources(), emit_mdim_vrt()
